### Observed differences

- Activity A01 was absent from the earlier window (0 of 200 traces) but appeared in the later window in every trace, exactly once per case, with no repetitions. [OCC001]
- The relationship between A01 and A16 changed completely: earlier, A16 occurred without A01 in 100% of traces (no co-occurrence at all); later, both occurred together in every trace, and always with A16 before A01. [REL001]
- Direct succession changed accordingly: earlier, no outgoing transition from A16 was observed in any trace; later, every observed outgoing transition of A16 (200 of 200) led directly to A01. [DIR001]
- Event positions are consistent with this: A16 previously sat at a fixed relative position of 1.0 in every trace, while in the later window its relative position averaged about 0.92 with small variation and A01 occupied relative position 1.0, i.e. the end of the trace. Note that positions measure event order, not clock time. [POS001, POS002]

### Inference

Support level: Supported hypothesis

The evidence supports the hypothesis that a new closing step A01 was introduced after A16: in the earlier window, cases ended with A16 and A01 never appeared, whereas in the later window every case executes A16 and then A01 exactly once. This rests on direct and mutually consistent evidence — A01's participation rose from 0 to 200 of 200 traces with exactly one occurrence per case, the pair relation switched from "A16 only" to "A16 before A01" in all traces, and A16 now leads directly to A01 on every observed occasion, with the positional shifts matching this picture. Five qualifying items against roughly 0.12 expected by chance for 25 tested units is a count that chance cannot plausibly produce, though all five items describe the same underlying trace behaviour and are therefore not independent confirmations. [OCC001, REL001, DIR001, POS001, POS002]

A competing explanation the evidence cannot fully rule out is that A01 already existed earlier but was simply never executed in the sampled window, since zero participation strictly means only "not observed"; similarly, the empty earlier outgoing profile of A16 shows that no successor was observed, not that A16 had none, so a replacement of an unobserved successor cannot be excluded. [OCC001, DIR001]
